description: This file is a PHP script that demonstrates usage of the Kint debugging library, including class definitions for User, BaseUser, and UserManager, as well as code that creates and manipulates user data, tabular data, and nested arrays, and outputs debug information and a theme switcher UI.

classes.name: BaseUser
classes.description: Base class for user objects with a method to get full name.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Derived user class with properties for username, password, created date, and methods for comparison, setting data, and triggering trace.

classes.name: UserManager
classes.description: Class managing User objects, with methods to get, debug, and ensure users.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this user is equal to another user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for the user.

methods.name: setAdditionalData
methods.description: Sets additional data for the user.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the user.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the user.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user object from the manager.

methods.name: debugUser
methods.description: Sets a user for debugging and outputs it.

methods.name: ensureUser
methods.description: Ensures the user, triggering its ensure method.
